description: This file is a shell script that contains embedded Node.js code to update and validate changelog entries related to pull requests in 'CHANGELOG.md'. It manages changelog sections, ensures PR references are correctly placed, and provides validation to maintain changelog hygiene in the project.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Normalizes PR entries in the changelog by moving entries to the 'Unreleased' section and ensuring proper subsection placement.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog includes the correct PR reference and that entries are correctly placed within the changelog sections.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures that merge conflicts have not resulted in dropped PR references without re-inclusion.
